newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late palm olein easier, demand weak.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late palm olein easier, demand weak.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were slightly lower in late trading on Tuesday on thin buying interest amid falls in Malaysia, traders said.

They said palm olein was mostly traded at 1,410-15 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, against 1,415 rupiah at the opening, but offers were also heard at 1,420 rupiah. Crude palm oil was on offer at 1,225 rupiah/kg in the North Sumatran city of Medan, where it was heard done at 1,220 rupiah on Monday.
"Falls in Malaysia dampened local sentiment," one trader said. "Some players are facing a shortage of prompt-delivery palm olein in Jakarta and were not offering any oil today."
